title: Plausible Clarifications of Implicit and Underspecified Instructions
description: Rate the plausibility of a candidate filler (clarification) for a gap in a wikiHow instructional text. Combines a multi-class judgment (IMPLAUSIBLE / NEUTRAL / PLAUSIBLE) with a graded 1-5 plausibility score. Based on SemEval-2022 Task 7 (Roth, Anthonio, and Sauer).
